summary: HematUangMu iter2 (JWT signup/login) — full backend + frontend regression. 20/20 pytest passed (register incl. duplicate/validation, login by username/phone-local/phone+62/UPPERCASE email/wrong-pw, JWT cookie+Bearer, Google session_token fallback still works via /api/auth/me, categories/transactions/analytics/telegram/parse smoke). Frontend: landing brand shows 'HematUangMu' (no 'CatatYuk'), nav-login-btn/nav-register-btn/hero-start-btn route correctly, /dashboard unauth redirects to /login, register submits and lands on /dashboard with summary cards (3) + charts (2), username-login works, wrong password shows 'Password salah'. Both auth flows coexist.

issues: Recharts console warning: ResponsiveContainer resolves width(-1)/height(-1) briefly on first paint. Cosmetic — chart still renders after layout settles. Consider setting min-height on chart container parent.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py logger name still 'catatyuk' (line 31) — cosmetic, not visible to user but should be renamed for consistency.

Login endpoint: identifier is lowercased for email/username match, but phone normalization is applied to the original ident (good). However norm_phone('') returns '' which then bypasses the empty regex check via `if phone_try` — safe.
auth_me returns full User model but not username/phone in the pydantic User model definition explicitly required — currently Optional fields OK.
Cookie samesite=none + secure=True requires HTTPS; works in preview but should be documented for local dev.
test_credentials: Tests create fresh user each run: username=tst_<uuid8>, email=tst_<uuid8>@gmail.com, phone=0812<uuid8>, password=SecretPass123. Cleaned up in test_zz_cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test users only; deleted at end of pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_auth_hematuangmu.py — reuse for future iterations. It uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env/frontend/.env. Google session_token flow is covered via direct Mongo insert (real emergent OAuth session cannot be mocked).
